Space model as built on 2026-09-22 (read from app/core/authorization.py and ownership.py): invite- or admin-created users have role member and zero Space memberships; nobody is auto-added to the Default Workspace; a spaceless member sees only rows they own; their new project lands in Default Workspace, which they cannot see as a Space; Space membership is all-or-nothing (every project in the Space and every child inherits); no project-level grant table exists; sole_space_id (GUEST-1) routes a member's new project to their one Space and falls back to Default with zero or several memberships. Derek's concern: Default fills up and gives people nothing of their own.
